components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single main action on a surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:12px 20px; min-height:44px; border:0; background:#5B4BE0; color:#FFFFFF; font:650 0.92rem 'Public Sans',sans-serif; border-radius:10px; box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(91,75,224,0.10); transition:background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#4938CF; transform:translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:12px 20px; min-height:44px; border:1px solid #E5E2DC; background:#FFFFFF; color:#22202A; font:650 0.92rem 'Public Sans',sans-serif; border-radius:10px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(34,31,40,0.04),0 4px 12px rgba(34,31,40,0.05); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:#F4F2ED; transform:translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Segment Control
components.css: .ds-segment { display:inline-flex; gap:3px; padding:4px; background:#EFEDE8; border-radius:999px; } .ds-segment button { border:0; background:transparent; color:#5E5B68; font:650 0.82rem 'Public Sans',sans-serif; padding:8px 16px; border-radius:999px; } .ds-segment button.active { background:#FFFFFF; color:#4A3AC9; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(34,31,40,0.04),0 4px 12px rgba(34,31,40,0.05); }

components.name: Card
components.description: A soft raised panel holding one idea.
components.css: .ds-card { background:#FFFFFF; border:1px solid #E5E2DC; border-radius:16px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(34,31,40,0.04),0 12px 30px rgba(34,31,40,0.08); padding:24px; }

components.name: Specimen Card
components.description: A distro card with a full screenshot plate and a caption strip.
components.html: TRAITS fixed · systemd · Cinnamon
components.css: .ds-specimen { display:flex; flex-direction:column; background:#FFFFFF; border:1px solid #E5E2DC; border-radius:16px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(34,31,40,0.04),0 12px 30px rgba(34,31,40,0.08); overflow:hidden; transition:transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-specimen:hover { transform:translateY(-4px); } .ds-caption { padding:12px 16px; background:#EFEDE8; font:0.78rem 'Public Sans',sans-serif; color:#5E5B68; }

narrative.overview: LinuxMatch feels like a calm, well-run studio desk: warm stone grounds, soft white cards that float gently, generous type and plain language. One indigo accent marks actions and choices. The earlier field-guide language was disciplined but cold; this world keeps the discipline and drops the distance.
keyCharacteristics: Warm stone and warm graphite grounds with identical role structure
Soft radii, layered shadows and generous spacing
One indigo accent reserved for action and selection
Plain-language labels and full, captioned screenshot plates

rules.name: The Action Rule
rules.body: Indigo marks something you can do or have chosen. If it decorates a static surface, remove it.

rules.name: The Plate Rule
rules.body: Show distro screenshots whole and caption them; never crop them into a false comparison.

dos: Do use verified catalogue data and local assets.
Do keep body text in Public Sans and measurements in Geist Mono.
Do write labels the way a person speaks.
Do preserve focus visibility and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't use gradients, neon glow, emoji icons or hard offset shadows.
Don't use uppercase mono headings or decorative kickers.
